description: This file provides type definitions and function signatures for a linked list data structure, including node and root node types, as well as functions for getting, setting, checking, and deleting list nodes by key.

methods.name: export function listGetNode<T, K>(list: RootNode<T, K>, key: ListNode<T, K>['key'], isDelete?: b/ listGetNode
methods.description: Retrieves a node from the list by its key, optionally deleting it if isDelete is true.

methods.name: listGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the key in the list, if present.

methods.name: listSet
methods.description: Sets or updates the value for a specific key in the list.

methods.name: listHas
methods.description: Checks whether a node with the specified key exists in the list.

methods.name: listDelete
methods.description: Removes a node with the specified key from the list.
